content.content:
8e17c7c fixed a bug. mCurPage should be set to null immediately when last page is popped, even if there is an transition animation to play
a138660 added support for page restore/recovery.
66126f4 refactored PageManager and Page to make the API calls more consistent.
f2dbecb refacoted PageManager to better support per-Page transition animations. added ViewWrapper.onMenuPressed() to handle press on the menu button
3c476c4 added a few more lifecycle methods, which may not be that useful in real life, they exist to make the framework complete :)
9927741 minor change to improve ZoomPageAnimator
04e9849 updated the docs
c1150c9 * reformat the entire project to use 2-space tab. * deprecate use of ViewWrapper.mContext, use getContext() instead. * some minor optimization and improvements.
c18799e added log messages for PageManager
85b9501 allow Page to customize transition animation.
51de900 rename
d7157ab refactored PageAnimationManager, passing Page instead of View as argument to methods of PageAnimationManager
c9f255d reverted 06d16b7b,  because the mAnimating flag may cause other problems, sometimes it will silently ignore some "popPage" operations, which in some cases is not expected.
05f23d3 fixed a bug that PageManager.popToClasses() did not work as expected.
f046940 renamed methods in PageManager and added PageManager.popToClasses(), and removed unnecessary methods.
a3ad79b argument rename
bfdfe7c added PageManager.lastIndexOfPage()
e1d2035 added PageManager.popPagesTillSpecifiedClass()
6287ba5 popPagesTillSpecifiedPage() needs not to take the "mAnimating" state into account, because this method is normally invoked programmatically.
b27a5ee added ViewWrapper.onAttach() & ViewWrapper.onDetach(), which are called when the view is added or removed from the view hierarchy.
42bc670 renamed the packages
650d538 ensures PageActivity read annotations from all subclasses in the inheritance hierarchy.
6cab13e fixed a bug in PageManager.popPagesTillSpecifiedPage(), which may pop all innocent pages expcept for the first one.
bcb02da seperated the project into a library & demo project.
9b93cce adjusted the order of method calling in PageManager.pushPage & PageManager.popPage
19c83ba fixed a bug that view of the removed page is not properly removed from the view container
964ad94 refactored Paginize, the refactor fixed a series of bugs.
06d16b7 improved PageManager
dde36f1 initial import

content.text: This confirms it. Before the fix, when `prevPage` is `null` (last page popped) and an animation is playing, `mCurPage` stays stale until the delayed `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` runs — this structure was introduced in `f2dbecb` and remained unchanged through `66126f4` and `a138660` (I verified via `git log --follow`) up to the fix commit.

66126f4 doesn't touch `mCurPage` logic at all, confirming the deferred assignment was untouched from f2dbecb until the bugfix.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: f2dbecb84ec45427f76bf02fc29fa1a8b2c9dd2e

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `PageManager.java` with `git log --follow`, then diffed the parent of the fix commit (`8e17c7c^`) to see the pre-fix state of `popPageInternal`/`doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal`. The pre-fix code deferred `mContainerView.removeView(removedPage.getView())` and `mCurPage = prevPage` into `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal`, which is only invoked immediately if there's no animation, or otherwise scheduled via `postDelayed` after `animationDuration`. I then searched backward through history for when this structure (the `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` split and the postDelayed deferral) was introduced.

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `f2dbecb` ("refacoted PageManager to better support per-Page transition animations...") restructured `popPageInternal`. Previously, `mContainerView.removeView(...)`, `removedPage.onDetach()`, and `mCurPage = prevPage` executed synchronously and immediately, *before* the animation delay logic. `f2dbecb` moved all of that into a new `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` method that gets deferred via `postDelayed` when animated. This means when the last page is popped (`prevPage == null`) with an animation, `mCurPage` remains pointing to the (now removed) page for the full animation duration instead of becoming `null` immediately — exactly the bug described in the fix commit message.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** 
- `git show f2dbecb -- PageManager.java` shows the exact diff moving `mCurPage = prevPage` (and the view removal) from immediate/synchronous code into the new deferred `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal`.
- I confirmed via `git show 66126f4` and inspection of `8e17c7c^` that no subsequent commit between `f2dbecb` and the fix touched this `mCurPage` assignment — it remained in the deferred position the entire time.
- The fix commit `8e17c7c` exactly reverses this: it moves `mContainerView.removeView(...)` and `mCurPage = prevPage` back out of `doFinalWorkForPopPageInternal` to execute immediately/synchronously in `popPageInternal`, matching the pre-`f2dbecb` behavior.

I'm confident in this identification since the fix is a near-exact structural reversal of the change made in `f2dbecb`, with no intervening commits modifying that logic.
